newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopian birr weakens further against the dollar.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopian birr weakens further against the dollar.

text.p: The Ethiopian birr was quoted marginally weaker compared to the dollar, the central National Bank of Ethiopia (NBE) said on Monday.
The bank quoted the birr at a mean rate of 6.6730 against the dollar compared to 6.6450 last week.
It said that following the currency auction on May 24, the applicable rate for all transactions outside the auction in the May 26 to June 1 period would be 6.6730 birr to the dollar.
The total amount of foreign exchange made available at the auction on Saturday was $14 million, the bank said.
It posted the birr at a mean rate of 10.8703 against the pound from 10.8944 last week, while against the yen the birr traded at 0.057645 from 0.057457 last week.
